Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.forms

Schnittstelle FieldHandler

Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
DefaultFieldHandler
public interface FieldHandler

Definition of an interface for accessing fields of a form.

A form consists of an arbitrary number of fields, i.e. interaction elements where the user can enter data. Such a field must be able to interact with the GUI widget used for data entering. In addition it supports validation of the entered data and conversion into a target data type.

  • Methodendetails

    • getComponentHandler

      ComponentHandler<?> getComponentHandler()
      Returns the ComponentHandler used by this FieldHandler. With this handler, the underlying GUI component can be controlled.
      Gibt zurück:
      the associated ComponentHandler

    • getData

      Object getData()
      Returns the data of this field. This is not necessary the same data object as returned by the ComponentHandler. Instead it can be the result of a conversion process to transform the data into a certain target data type. For this conversion to succeed it must be ensured that this method is only envoked after validation at the field level has been successfull. The object returned here should be of the same type as returned by getType().
      Gibt zurück:
      the data of this field

    • setData

      void setData(Object data)
      Sets the data of this field. An implementation must perform suitable conversions and then write the data into the associated GUI component. This is the opposite of getData().
      Parameter:
      data - the data to set

    • validate

      ValidationResult validate(ValidationPhase phase)
      Validates this field either at the field or the form level. The returned ValidationResult object contains information if the field's content is valid or which errors have been found.
      Parameter:
      phase - determines the validation phase
      Gibt zurück:
      an object with the validation results

    • getType

      Class<?> getType()
      Returns the data type for this field. Valid user input will be converted into this data type.
      Gibt zurück:
      the data type of this field

    • getPropertyName

      String getPropertyName()
      Returns the name of the corresponding property in the form bean. This method can return null, which means that the bean property has the same name as this field. But by specifying a different name it is possible to map to more complex bean properties, e.g. mapped or indexed ones.
      Gibt zurück:
      the name of the corresponding bean property

    • getDisplayName

      String getDisplayName()
      Returns the display name of this field. This should be a plain name in the language of the current user. The method can return null if no display name has been set. In this case the form will use the field name also as display name.
      Gibt zurück:
      a display name for this field
